python3 -c "
import re
lines = open('/root/runs/importance_margin_vla_compress/train_openvla_sc_m128_seed42.log').readlines()
losses = []
for l in lines:
    m = re.search(r'step=(\d+)/\d+\s+loss=([\d.]+)', l)
    if m:
        losses.append((int(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2))))
last100 = losses[-100:]
vals = [v for _,v in last100]
first50 = vals[:50]
last50 = vals[50:]
print(f'total_entries={len(losses)}')
print(f'last100_range=step {last100[0][0]} to {last100[-1][0]}')
print(f'mean_100={sum(vals)/len(vals):.4f}')
print(f'mean_first50={sum(first50)/len(first50):.4f}')
print(f'mean_last50={sum(last50)/len(last50):.4f}')
print(f'min={min(vals):.4f} max={max(vals):.4f}')
print(f'has_nan={any(\"nan\" in str(v).lower() for v in vals)}')
"
